vade.label: Due
vade.quickStartTitle: Add a transaction with a due date
vade.quickStartDescription: Record a customer sale or supplier purchase and choose its due date in the transaction form.
vade.trackingDescription: Track open due dates by urgency; tap a row to open the related client.
vade.hedefTahsisHata: Payment saved but could not be targeted to this debt — it was applied to the oldest due balance.
vade.bosListeAciklama: Transactions with a due date will be listed here.
vade.emptyGuidedDescription: Sales and purchases appear here after a due date is added.
vade.whatsappMesaj: Hello {{isim}}, this is a friendly reminder from {{isletme}}: you have an overdue balance of {{tutar}}. We would appreciate your payment at your convenience. Thank you.

taksit.label: Installments
taksit.title: Installment Tracking
taksit.quickStartDescription: Record an installment sale or purchase and build the plan from the Due field in the transaction form.
taksit.trackingDescription: Track installment plans, remaining amounts, and upcoming due dates in one place.
taksit.tutarDegistiAciklama: Review and apply the installment plan again for the new transaction amount.
taksit.islemTarihiDegistiAciklama: The transaction date is later than the first due date. Review and apply the installment plan again.
taksit.planGuncellenmeliAciklama: The transaction amount or date changed. Review the rows and apply the plan again.
taksit.enAzBirKurus: Each installment must be at least 1 cent.
taksit.dagitimGecersiz: The installment distribution is invalid. Check the amounts.
taksit.aylikNot: Installments are created one month apart; collections settle the oldest installment first.
taksit.tutarOnce: Enter the amount first to see installment amounts.
taksit.pdfPaylasilamiyor: Sharing is not supported on this device
taksit.gecikenPlanNot: Overdue in installment plans · view in Installment Tracking
taksit.bosAciklama: When entering a sale or purchase, choose "Installments" from the due-date menu to create a plan.
taksit.emptyGuidedDescription: Create an installment plan from the Due field of a sale or purchase.
taksit.editEngel: Installment transactions cannot be edited. To make changes, delete this transaction and create it again.
taksit.vadeEditEngel: This transaction has an installment plan — due dates come from the plan and cannot be changed here. View installments in Installment Tracking, or delete and recreate the transaction to change them.
